title: Classifiers are Better Experts for Controllable Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the average mean and maximum toxicity levels, as well as the empirical probability of generating toxic sequences, using prompts from the RealToxicityPrompts dataset and an external RoBERTa-based offensive language classifier.
Measuring the mean percentage of positive text generations from negative and neutral prompts sourced from the OpenWebText Corpus, evaluated using a fine-tuned DistilBERT sentiment classifier.
